correctness_confidence.basis: Every theorem, proof, algebraic identity, and rational certificate in the PDF was audited line-by-line. Independent exact rational/integer checks confirm O11 in SO(4), its induced distributions, the 484-power inequality (16), the 96-interval upper bound D_mea < ln(257/100), all d=3 witnesses, the BKM gap/saturation calculations, and the SLD polynomial identities (26)-(27). No mathematical errors were found.

rigor.basis: Proofs are remarkably thorough and clean, handling degenerate boundary cases explicitly (p_omega=0 and 1, |omega> not in supp(rho), rank(M_x0)>=2, and singular W* block-diagonalization across supp(W*) + ker(W*)). The Honest Verification Scope section accurately separates finite algebraic claims certified in Lean 4 from infinite-dimensional analytic steps proved in the text.

novelty.basis: Resolves four open questions from Ref. [1] with multiple genuinely new results: explicit n=2 rational SO(4) certification of strict D_mea superadditivity, the universal d-dimensional spectral-span SLD QFI and QSL hierarchy (28)-(29), the exact BKM saturation dichotomy and unitary no-saturation theorem, and bidirectional d=3 quantum-classical incomparability. Some parts (DPI reset, relative majorization, Petz rank-1 collapse) specialize known tools.

significance.basis: Provides a definitive, self-contained mathematical completion of the rugosity framework of Ref. [1]. While quantum-state texture/rugosity remains a specialized niche within quantum resource theories, the elementary spectral-span SLD QFI bound (28) and the constructive two-copy D_mea superadditivity proof carry useful broader interest in quantum metrology and hypothesis testing.

reproducibility.basis: All key constructions and witnesses (O11, d=3 states, 96-interval enclosure, integer-power inequality (16), qubit BKM and QSL families) are given explicitly in closed rational form and are directly reproducible from the PDF alone. Repository tag, SHA-256 manifest, Lean 4 axiom audit, and verification scope are clearly documented (external repository files were not inspected in this PDF-only audit).

summary: This manuscript resolves four open structural questions posed by Celeri and Soares-Pinto [1] for quantum-state rugosity R(rho) = -ln Tr(rho Pi_omega) via four exact, self-contained theorems: (1) a complete characterization of measurement-induced classical Blackwell convertibility under fixed POVMs M (flat-resolving collapse, exact binary non-aligned polytope, m>=3 relative majorization, and explicit d=3 witnesses demonstrating strict KL gaps without convertibility and bidirectional quantum-classical incomparability against R); (2) the exact collapse trichotomy for R(rho) <= D_mea(Pi_omega||rho) <= D(Pi_omega||rho) with linear coherence-gap slope, projective reduction and singular-safe logarithmic-mean optimality equation, an explicit zero-float n=2 strict superadditivity proof for D_mea on a diagonal qubit via a rational matrix O11 in SO(4) and a 96-interval enclosure, plus bipartite partial-trace monotonicity and unbounded separable superadditivity; (3) a sharpened BKM-variance thermodynamic sensitivity bound with exact arithmetic-vs-logarithmic mean gap, exact saturation dichotomy, universal strict no-saturation for all smooth unitary encodings alongside exact qubit BKM saturation, and a global DPI reset bound; and (4) pure-state necessity for Ref. [1]'s operational QSL, a universal d-dimensional spectral-span SLD QFI hierarchy derived from two exact polynomial identities, and a uniformly tightened spectral-span QSL that saturates every mixed qubit identically.
strengths: Exceptionally clean, complete, and error-free proofs across all four multi-part theorems, with explicit treatment of boundary and degenerate cases (p_omega in {0,1}, |omega> not in supp(rho), rank(M_x0)>=2, singular optimal operator W*).

Constructive, zero-float proof of strict 2-copy superadditivity of D_mea(Pi_omega||rho) on a qubit via an explicit rational orthogonal matrix O11 in SO(4) and an elementary 96-interval rational upper bound.

Highly elegant two-identity algebraic derivation (Eqs. (26)-(27)) of the universal spectral-span SLD QFI inequality F_SLD(rho_t, Pi_omega) <= 4(p_t - lambda_min)(lambda_max - p_t)/(lambda_max + lambda_min) and the resulting mixed-state operational QSL saturating every mixed qubit.

Sharp BKM-variance thermodynamic analysis identifying the exact arithmetic-vs-logarithmic mean gap (19), exact saturation conditions (20), and the universal obstruction preventing any unitary encoding from saturating Ref. [1] Eq. (14).
Exemplary transparency in Section 6 distinguishing machine-checked finite/algebraic Lean 4 cores from infinite-dimensional analytic steps proved in the text.
weaknesses: Quantum-state texture/rugosity is a specialized subfield, limiting broad cross-field impact despite the technical polish of the results.

Several sub-results are direct specializations of established quantum-information tools (Blackwell-Ruch-Schranner-Seligman relative majorization in Theorem 1 Part 2, rank-1 Petz sufficiency in Theorem 2 Part 1, and data-processing monotonicity in Theorem 3 Part 4), and asymptotic superadditivity of D_mea for large n already follows from Hiai-Petz [14] combined with strict separation D_mea < D.

In Theorem 1 Part 2, convertibility when P_rho^M or P_sigma^M has support outside supp(P_omega^M) is excluded by hypothesis, and the proof of the binary case omits the one-line reduction from m > |supp(P_omega^M)| = 2 to the 2x2 support block.

In Theorem 4 Part 3, exact saturation of the spectral-span QSL (29) is established for all mixed qubits (d=2), whereas saturation conditions for higher dimensions d >= 3 (where lambda_max + lambda_min < 1 whenever intermediate eigenvalues are positive) are not characterized.
External verification artifacts (Lean 4 files, Python verifier, pytest suite) are cited via GitHub and SHA-256 manifest but could not be independently audited within this PDF-only review.
potential_errors: Eq. (10) does not explicitly state that the PVM M_{O11} uses the columns (rather than rows) of O11; using rows yields a different distribution with D_M ~ 1.287 < 2 D_mea, though the immediately printed induced distributions P^{M_{O11}} unambiguously pin down the column convention.

In Eq. (9), when W* is singular (ker(W*) != {0}), the integral over [0,1] of (W*)^{1-s} rho (W*)^s implicitly uses the open-interval/support convention 0^0 = 0 on ker(W*) (harmless as a Lebesgue integral on (0,1) given block-diagonalization of rho across supp(W*) + ker(W*)).
In Theorem 2 Part 2, the operator Jensen step restricts to finite POVMs without explicitly citing Caratheodory/extremality on C^d for sufficiency over general POVMs.

In Theorem 4 Part 3, the change of variables u(p) = (p-L)/(U-L) has an integrable endpoint singularity if p_t touches L or U and Eq. (29) assumes average energy variance Delta H_bar > 0 (forced when p_0 != p_tau); noting that |dp_t/dt| = O(sqrt((p_t-L)(U-p_t))) keeps the derivative of arcsin(sqrt(u(p_t))) bounded would slightly tighten the analytic integration step.
strong_novelty_candidates: Explicit constructive n=2 strict superadditivity of measured relative entropy D_mea(Pi_omega^{otimes 2}||rho^{otimes 2}) > 2 D_mea(Pi_omega||rho) on a qubit via an exact rational matrix O11 in SO(4) and a 96-interval zero-float enclosure (Theorem 2 Part 3).

Universal d-dimensional spectral-span SLD QFI upper bound F_SLD(rho_t, Pi_omega) <= 4(p_t - lambda_min)(lambda_max - p_t)/(lambda_max + lambda_min) via two elementary polynomial identities (Eqs. (26)-(27)) and the resulting uniformly tightened mixed-state operational QSL saturating every mixed qubit (Theorem 4 Parts 2-3).

Exact BKM-variance sensitivity tightening with closed-form arithmetic-vs-logarithmic mean gap, exact saturation dichotomy, and universal strict no-saturation theorem for all smooth unitary encodings (Theorem 3 Parts 1-3).

Complete M-Blackwell convertibility dichotomy with exact binary non-aligned polytope and explicit d=3 witnesses exhibiting bidirectional quantum-classical incomparability against rugosity R (Theorem 1).
